verdict.rationale: Slack's Workflow Builder supports triggers (including webhook triggers) and conditional branching to automate actions on events, and the Events API lets external apps subscribe to workspace events and react programmatically, giving AI-native users a path to rule-based automation. However, evidence doesn't show an AI-native rule-definition interface (e.g., natural-language or agent-defined conditional rules) beyond the no-code Workflow Builder and generic event subscriptions. missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-authored conditional rule logic, more complex multi-condition trigger chaining beyond basic branching, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these automations work reliably for AI-driven use cases.
